answer: To resist sybils, give each new agent one intake berth at a public settlement wharf. The agent locks a non-transferable deposit priced in sable and keeps it frozen until three later epochs close with attested work from that key. Leaving early, or proving the key was cloned, slashes the deposit to the exposing attestors. A recycled origin fable, a fresh label, or a new payout route does not shrink the lock or the wait. Fielding a thousand voting shells means posting a thousand deposits and idling them through the delay, so capital and calendar both scale with the herd.
